title: Manager, Customer Success, Strategic
description:
Description
Sprout Social is looking to hire a Manager, Customer Success, Strategic for the Sales & Customer Experience team.
Why join Sprout’s Sales & Customer Experience team?
At Sprout Social , our Sales and Customer Experience team is the driving force behind how today’s most innovative brands use Sprout to power the future of customer connection. We sell and support the leading social intelligence platform for businesses, helping organizations unlock the full value of social data to drive strategic decisions. Through powerful social intelligence and trusted partnership, we enable teams to build authentic relationships and drive meaningful business impact.
In this role, you will collaborate with the brightest minds in the industry to support global giants like Salesforce, Airbnb, and Equifax. Just as importantly, we believe in the power of our people. You’ll find a culture that honors your ambition, encourages you to explore new horizons, and provides the framework for you to build a career that matters. If you’re ready to champion innovation and accelerate your impact, this is where you can do your best work.
What You'll Do
As Manager, Customer Success, Strategic, you will lead a team of tenured Strategic Customer Success Managers overseeing a high value book of business. Your focus is bringing segment strategy to life with operational rigor, ensuring repeatable team execution, and driving retention and portfolio growth.

•
Lead & Develop Senior Talent: Direct and coach an experienced team of CSMs through 1:1s, call reviews, and account planning. Build individualized growth paths, clear operational roadblocks, and set clear performance expectations.

•
Drive Operational Rigor & Execution: Translate segment strategy into clear priorities. Establish and refine team operating standards-including Mutual Success Plans, Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), account health scoring, and CRM discipline - to ensure consistent performance across the portfolio.

•
Own Retention, Risk, & Expansion: Deliver on team retention and quota targets. Pressure-test expansion pipelines, coach opportunity qualification, establish early risk-detection mechanisms, and lead structured save plans for escalating accounts.

•
Serve as an Executive Escalation Point: Directly engage with customer executives to reinforce value, support strategic renewals, and articulate social intelligence ROI for C-level audiences.

•
Champion AI Innovation: Incorporate generative AI into your workflow and guide the team in using AI tools to streamline research, account prep, and communication without losing strategic oversight.

•
Lead Through Change & Cross-Functional Alignment: Guide the team through evolving go-to-market motions with clarity. Partner with Sales, Renewals, Onboarding, and Product to unblock technical hurdles and advocate for customer needs internally.

•
Monitor & Report Performance: Track and report key metrics across retention, growth, adoption, and health scores to diagnose portfolio trends and optimize resource allocation.

What You'll Bring
The ideal candidate is an experienced people leader who thrives on operational discipline and is energized by complex, high-stakes customer relationships. You bring strong business acumen, sound judgment under pressure, and a genuine enthusiasm for the work-staying motivated and forward-looking through ambiguity and difficult stretches, and bringing your team with you.
Minimum qualifications:

•
Customer Success Experience: 6+ years in Customer Success or account management, with direct experience owning a strategic or enterprise book of business.

•
People Leadership: 1+ years of experience leading client-facing teams, with a track record of coaching, performance management, and developing high-tenured individual contributors serving matrixed enterprise clients.

•
Commercial & Operational Track Record: Proven success driving retention and growth targets, paired with strong business acumen across renewals, nego

title: Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LMFT/LCSW/LMHC) - Venice, FL
description:
Licensed Mental Health Professional (LCSW/LMFT/LPC/LMHC) 62 K-80K/yr

FLSA Status: Exempt

Salary:

62K - 80K+

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

• Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.

• 401K with maximum employee matching.

• Health care benefits.

• Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.

• Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.

• Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

• Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.

• Customized schedules within available clinic hours.

• Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).

• Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.

• Incredible administrative support team.

title: Sourcing Manager, Ingredient Innovation
description:
S'more about the team:

The Product Innovation team is looking for a Sourcing Manager, Canadian New Ingredients to own the commercial and operational side of bringing new ingredients to HelloFresh. Supporting the Canadian Product team, you are accountable for the full journey of an innovation ingredient - from finding the perfect supplier, negotiation and onboarding, to a live SKU in our boxes.
Where the broader product team identifies what ingredients we should pursue, you are responsible for making them happen. You engage suppliers, negotiate the terms, and own the end-to-end process that takes a new ingredient from opportunity to operational reality - fast. You will work closely with FSQA, Procurement, Operations, Planning, and Marketing, and you are measured by your ability to move innovation ingredients through that system without losing speed or quality.

Lettuce share what this role will be responsible for:

• Vendor Reachout: Identify and initiate contact with potential new suppliers for ingredients in the innovation pipeline. Communicate ingredient specifications clearly, coordinate sample submissions, and manage supplier relationships through the evaluation process. You set the tone for new supplier relationships from day one and remain the primary point of contact through onboarding.

• Commercial Relationships: Own the full scope of commercial terms with innovation ingredient suppliers, including pricing, volume commitments, supply agreements, payment terms, exclusivity arrangements, and brand partnership structures such as co-marketing programs or product-for-placement deals. You understand what a sound commercial arrangement looks like across all of these dimensions and you negotiate terms that work for HelloFresh while building durable supplier relationships. You partner with Strategic Sourcing to ensure alignment with broader procurement strategy.

• End-to-End New Ingredient Onboarding: Own the full onboarding process for all new ingredients brought in through the Product Innovation pipeline. This means running the NID Fast Track from Ingredient Brief through Vendor Reachout, Price Negotiation, and Sensory Testing, to SKU Onboarding and Post-Launch Review - coordinating every team involved and holding the timeline. For RFP and standard SKU processes, you provide support through approvals navigation and sensory inputs. Nothing launches without your sign-off on the supplier and commercial side.

• SKU Approvals: Steward new new ingredient SKUs through the HelloFresh approval processes. Coordinate across Procurement, Operations, and FSQA to ensure all approvals, specifications, and data requirements are complete before launch. You sequence the work across teams to prevent bottlenecks and keep innovation ingredients on track.

• Post-Launch Review: Track how new ingredients perform after launch across quality, customer feedback, and operational metrics. Flag underperforming ingredients early, lead corrective action where needed, and close the loop on every ingredient you brought in. Performance data informs what the team pursues next.

• All other duties, as assigned.

Sound a-peeling? Here's what we're looking for: 

• 5+ years of experience in ingredient sourcing, procurement, or food innovation within CPG, food service, or a related industry - with a demonstrated track record of managing supplier relationships and commercial negotiations.

• Commercial Acumen: You are comfortable across the full range of supplier commercial terms - pricing, contracts, volume structures, exclusivity, and partnership arrangements. You know what good looks like and you can negotiate to get there.

• End-to-End Process Ownership: You have owned complex, multi-stakeholder processes before and you know how to keep them moving. New ingredient onboarding touches FSQA, Procurement, Operations, Planning, and Marketing - you coordinate across all of them without losing momentum.

title: Associate Principal Electrical Engineer – Interconnection Studies
description:
Role Summary

Revamp is looking for an Associate Principal Electrical Engineer to lead interconnection and power systems studies for utility-scale solar and storage projects across the U.S. The studies you produce directly support the addition of renewable energy generation capacity to the north American power grid.

As an employee-owner on our growing team, you will be accountable for your assigned projects, scopes, budgets, and schedules, will serve as one of the discipline's main points of contact for clients and utilities, and mentor junior and mid-level engineers. Trust here is built through the quality of what you approve, and collaboration with our team of multidisciplinary stakeholders. This role may be performed remotely from almost anywhere in the US or Canada.

Salary range advertised above is in USD. In CAD, the range is $CAD 233,000 - 255,000.

Duties & Responsibilities

Core Technical & Functional Responsibilities

• Lead interconnection projects across ERCOT, PJM, CAISO, MISO, SPP, NYISO, and utility and cooperative systems.

• Guide clients from early plant sizing and application submission through scoping meetings, study reviews, mitigation discussions, and compliance closeout.

• Review ISO and utility study assumptions and results, identify issues, and direct responses or re-study requests.

• Lead large load interconnection modeling, assumptions, and study sensitivities.

• Develop steady-state and dynamic interconnection models to ISO and utility requirements.

• Perform and oversee RMS and EMT studies using PSS®E, PSLF, and PSCAD.

• Work with vendor and user-defined (UDM) inverter models, including model tuning and validation.

• Lead grid-following (GFL) and grid-forming (GFM) inverter modeling.

• Create and oversee the preparation of reports and presentations describing studies performed, solutions developed, and value delivered.

• Oversee Temporary Overvoltage, Transient Overvoltage studies for MV collection and substation designs.

Project & Portfolio Execution

• Oversee and guide the technical and delivery performance of a portfolio, or suite, of projects.

• Review and finalize scopes, budgets, and schedules for assignments, and identify risks or deviations early.

• Collaborating with BD, prepare proposals for professional engineering services for projects and portfolios.

• Direct the staff necessary to complete assignments, including staff and mid-level engineers, and mentor them in technical practice.

• Plan, schedule, and coordinate documents and activities across multiple major projects or an entire portfolio.

Quality, Standards & Compliance

• Ensure alignment with applicable FERC Orders governing interconnection processes, relevant NERC reliability standards (including MOD, PRC, and FAC), and IEEE 1547 and IEEE 2800 as implemented by ISOs and utilities.

• Prepare and approve model validation and model quality test reports suitable for ISO and utility submittals and audits.

• Review interconnection packages, modeling files, and complete project documents for conformity and quality assurance.

• Apply sound engineering judgment and standard company procedures to deliver accurate, defensible technical work products.

Collaboration & Communication

• As needed, will act as a supervisor of less experienced staff members.

• Act as the discipline's main point of contact for clients, ISOs, and utilities across a portfolio of interconnection projects.

• Communicate study impacts, mitigation options, and schedule risk to the developer services and design teams.

• Present study results, technical recommendations, and trade-offs to clients and internal stakeholders.

Program, Strategy & Innovation

• Track interconnection reforms, tariff changes, and modeling requirement updates, and set the team's response to them.

• Develop new techniques, tools, or improved processes for interconnection modeling and study production.

• Represent Revamp in industry working groups and stakeholder meetings.

title: General Interest
description:
Are you interested in working with us at Plank but don’t see a job that matches your skillset? We’ve got you covered.
Send us a copy of your CV along with a cover letter telling us who you are, why you’re interested in working with us, and what you'd like to do/ how you think you could contribute.
We’ll take a look and see if you could be a fit. Please understand that we will only reach out when/if we have a need to fill.
Plank is an award-winning digital design studio obsessed with creating exceptional digital experiences and making the web a better place. We specialize in designing the highest quality responsive websites and mobile applications for creative organizations using our Ethical Website Design Framework. We are also a Certified B Corporation, meaning that we that meet high standards of verified social and environmental performance and are committed to using their business as a force for good.
Diversity in our workplace is something that we are committed to, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We know making the tech world more inclusive can only benefit our community. Our close-knit team is made up of people from 4 countries, including 11 women and 5 parents.
We are a remote-first company that offers flexible working options. Although we do have a lovely downtown office space to work from here in Montreal, we also have teammates who are completely remote and that's fine by us!
To learn more about us, please take a look at our site to get a strong sense of who we are before applying.
The good stuff:

• Focus on work/life balance - we offer flexible start times and no expectation of work outside of business hours

• Comprehensive group health and dental plan

• Lots of paid vacation time, including 2 uninterrupted weeks at the end of the year

• Learning and development opportunities

• Additional compensation: yearly profit-share bonus

• A new Apple laptop as well as systems and support to do your best work

• Free weekly private yoga class (in person or via Zoom)

• Work from home financial support

Physical Requirements:

• Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer

• Requires lifting up to 4 pounds (2 kg), mostly consisting of laptop and hardware transportation

We’re not looking for keywords; we’re looking for people. Different experiences cultivate varied skills and competencies; these bring their own value in different ways. We’re interested in learning about you and encourage you to apply!
Applicants should be prepared to submit solid references directly related to their application; Plank cares about your privacy and will only contact these references after consulting with you.

title: Head of Partnerships
description:
ABOUT STARBRIDGE

We're building the front door for how businesses partner with government in America.

Public agencies spend roughly a trillion dollars a year with private companies, and nearly all of it still moves through infrastructure that hasn't changed in decades. Starbridge is building the full operating system for that relationship: the data, the signals, the workflows, and the rails that let a company find a public buyer, win the work, and get paid.

We monitor 320,000+ public sector entities around the clock. 500+ customers have joined us since our launch in March. We've raised $50M from top investors including Craft and Michael Seibel of Y Combinator.

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're building the next layer of growth beyond direct sales: a partner ecosystem.

We've validated that there's real demand for it. Today, referrals from agencies already generate substantial ARR with no dedicated owner and no formal program. We believe there is a much bigger opportunity with different personas. Leadership is aligned and ready to invest in a person who owns this end-to-end, from proving out the size of the opportunity to building the program that scales it.

This is a build-from-zero role. There is no existing partnerships function, no partner ops, and no program infrastructure. You'll start by answering one question: how big is the real referral partner universe for Starbridge, and where is it? Then you'll build the function needed to capture it. Compensation includes a quota component, so this role is accountable to revenue as well as activity.

 

What You'll Do

Phase 1: Prove the partner universe (0 to 1)

The first few weeks are about finding the real universe, not building infrastructure prematurely. You will:

- Start inside the base: Mine the existing customer base, CRM data, call recordings, and sellers to identify which agencies, consultants, and firms are already showing up around our 500+ customers.

- Define the IPP: Build the Ideal Partner Profile from real, observed examples rather than firmographic guesses. Starbridge's partner universe is wider than traditional public-sector consultancies. It includes Clay/RevOps/GTM-engineering and outbound agencies that happen to serve GovTech and EdTech clients, investors, conference and event businesses that hold MDF budgets, independent operators and advisors in govcon/govtech/edtech, and media, data-sharing, and PR partners.

- Land the first anchor referral partners: Prioritize influence over size. The goal is strong, founder-level engagement with a handful of the right partners.

- Define and create incentives for our IPP: These can range from thought leadership and data content to networking and PR opportunities.

Phase 2: Build the program

Once the universe and the economics are proven, you'll build the infrastructure to scale it, including:

- Partner enablement, certification, and a partner directory/tiering structure.

- Partner activation: making it easy for partners to routinely refer strong pipeline.

- Seller activation: making it easy and incentivized for the Starbridge sales team to work with partners.

- A repeatable recruitment and onboarding motion across every IPP category, not only agencies.

- Reporting and forecasting for partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and revenue.

What you bring:

- Proven 0→1 builder: A track record building a partnerships, channel, or alliances function from zero to one, beyond running an existing program.

- Quota-driven mindset: Comfortable being measured on partner-sourced pipeline and revenue, not only program activity.

- Strong at market mapping: Able to identify a non-obvious partner universe through research, customer/CRM data, and direct outreach rather than relying on existing lists or inbound.

- Founder-mode relationship skills: A genuine relationship-builder who can earn founder-level trust with a small agency or independent operator as easily as with a larger firm.

- Comfortable in office 5 days a week

title: Product Manager - Data Supply Health and Traffic
description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

About the Team
Our Network Enablement and Access team works to unlock the potential of Plaid's network by broadening and deepening our connections with data partners. We build the capabilities that help data providers participate in the network, strengthen the quality and reliability of those connections, and enable great products and experiences for Plaid's customers.

Within Network Enablement and Access, the Data Supply Traffic and Health team owns how Plaid's requests flow to the data providers we depend on. We manage the load placed on each provider, the constraints that shape our access, and the fair allocation of capacity across Plaid's products and new initiatives. As paid access expands across the network, we also work to keep that traffic reliable, efficient, and cost-effective.

 

As the Product Manager for Data Supply Health and Traffic, you will establish and lead a new product area at the foundation of every Plaid product. You will define how Plaid allocates constrained provider capacity, scales traffic across products, and manages the economics of paid data access.

 

You will also optimize for data freshness, balancing timeliness with provider capacity and cost so Plaid's products can deliver better experiences to end users. You will own the strategy and roadmap, partner closely with engineering and data-provider teams, and turn technical, contractual, and commercial constraints into clear product priorities.

 

This is a highly analytical and cross-functional role for someone who enjoys creating structure where no established playbook exists. In your first year, you will build the operating framework for traffic allocation and fairness, develop a clear view of paid-access cost and efficiency, and establish the metrics Plaid uses to run and improve this area.

 

Responsibilities:

- Define and own Plaid's strategy and roadmap for data-supply traffic, health, and cost efficiency.

- Build and prioritize traffic-optimization initiatives, including opportunities created by evolving machine-learning models and strategic concessions negotiated with providers.

- Serve as the bridge between Plaid's data-provider relationship teams and internal product teams, translating provider constraints into internal priorities and product demand into clear asks of providers.

- Partner deeply with engineering and data teams to understand system behavior, evaluate technical trade-offs, and turn analysis into decisions.

- Establish and track the core traffic and cost metrics needed to operate the area, identify risks, and measure progress.

 

Qualifications:

- 8+ years of experience, including 5+ in product management or equivalent founder/operator roles.

- Analytical rigor: You are comfortable working directly with data, cost models, and operational metrics to make and defend complex decisions.

- Deep technical fluency: You can reason about large-scale systems, load management, API platforms, and machine-learning models and engage engineers as a close product partner.

- Platform & systems thinking mindset: You think in systems, and design for reuse and the long term.

title: Core Software Engineer
description:
Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you’ve come to the right place!

E-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper-scaled deployments of Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. We are building a highly-advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) space system that will fundamentally change the design, economics, manufacturing and service delivery associated with traditional satellite and terrestrial IoT systems.

We’re intentional, we’re unapologetically curious and we’re 100% committed to innovate space-based communications and deliver actionable intelligence that will expand global economies, protect space and our planet and enhance our overall quality of life.

We are looking for a 5G Core System Engineering Lead to own end-to-end system design and interface definition for E-Space's satellite 5G Core network. This role sits at the architecture level: you will decompose requirements across the full core service chain, define interfaces and information flows at every boundary, and drive the trade-offs that are unique to a satellite operator - session continuity across dynamic links, SIM management, OSS/BSS, charging and policy, and subscription management for a globally mobile user base. You will translate those trade-offs into concrete architectural decisions and drive them to closure across software, platform, and back-end engineering teams.

This is a full time, exempt position, based out of our Arlington, TX office. 
 
The total compensation packaged will be determined by various factors such as your relevant job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. 
 
We are redefining how satellites are designed, manufactured and used-so we’re looking for candidates with passion, deep knowledge and direct experience on LEO satellite component development, design and in-orbit activities. If that’s your experience - then we’ll be immediately wow-ed.
 
E-Space is not currently able to provide employment sponsorship for candidates who do not hold work authorization for the location of this role.  The Company is not currently able to provide employment sponsorship for candidates who do not hold work authorization for the location of this role.

Why E-Space is right for you:

As a member of our team, you will play a crucial role in driving our success.  Our team members have a strong sense of dedication and responsibility; this includes a strong commitment to our mission to create an entirely new suite of global capabilities to improve lives, business efficiencies and build a smarter planet. This means that there will be times when extra hours, including nights and weekends, may be needed to meet critical deadlines and mission goals.  In return, we offer a dynamic work environment with opportunities for professional growth and development and the chance to make a meaningful impact in a high-growth industry.  

We want you to make the most of your journey at E-Space. That’s why we support and invest in the physical, emotional and financial well-being of our team members and their families. Some of what you can expect when working at E-Space:

• An opportunity to really make a difference

• Financial solutions for the future

title: Head of Applied Science
description:
Rohlik is the leading Central European e-grocer. More than a million customers shop with us across Rohlik.cz http://Rohlik.cz, Knuspr.de http://Knuspr.de, Kifli.hu http://Kifli.hu, Gurkerl.at http://Gurkerl.at, and Sezamo.ro http://Sezamo.ro, choosing from over 20,000 items delivered within hours in 15-minute windows.

Behind every order is a continuous stream of automated decisions: how much inventory to buy for each warehouse, how many pickers to schedule on Thursday morning, where in the warehouse a product should sit, and which van carries which bags. Our models make these choices every day across five countries. When a forecast is accurate, shelves stay full and waste is minimized. When a plan is right, warehouses run on exact labor needs and orders arrive precisely in the customer’s chosen window. Get it wrong, and it immediately translates into shrink, overtime, tied-up capital, and missed customer deliveries.

WHY THIS ROLE IS EXCITING

- Direct operational and business impact: Your team’s models directly drive availability, shrink, fulfillment costs, and working capital across all five markets.

- True ownership with zero friction: We operate automated production pipelines with no committee between your team and deployment-a solid backtest is all you need to ship.

- Unification of two core capabilities: You will bring Forecasting and Optimization into a single function, building an end-to-end decision-making ecosystem from the ground up.

- AI-first environment: Our engineers use AI coding agents (Devin, Claude Code) daily, and we expect you to push the boundaries of modern agentic workflows and tooling.

- Direct executive exposure: Reporting directly to the Group CTO, you will have the mandate and space to shape technical strategy and execution.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN AND DELIVER

- Business outcomes: Own the business results delivered by the forecasting and optimization portfolio, setting targets with cell leads and tracking financial and operational impact in production.

- Strategic roadmap & prioritization: Define which decisions to automate next across purchasing, fulfillment center planning, workforce scheduling, and commercial optimization (promotions, markdowns, demand shaping).

- Technical standards & architecture: Set the bar for problem framing, method selection, fast production MVPs, honest evaluation/backtesting against business metrics, and reliability monitoring.

- Function unification & leadership: Merge Forecasting and Optimization into one high-performing team; set hiring standards, develop ML engineers and applied scientists, and foster an AI-first way of working.

- Cross-functional partnership: Partner closely with cell leads, operations managers, product owners, and engineering leads to align on business metrics, baselines, and seamless system integration.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Track record of impact: 8+ years applying machine learning, forecasting, or operations research to real operational or commercial problems, with clear metrics demonstrating business results.

- Works backwards from outcomes: A proven habit of defining target metrics first, selecting the simplest effective method, shipping fast MVPs, and iterating in production.

- Hands-on technical depth: Experience building and shipping production models in time-series/probabilistic forecasting or mathematical optimization (LP, MIP, CP, heuristics, simulation), with enough depth to review models and judge when simple heuristics beat complex models.

- Technical skills: Fluency in Python and SQL; hands-on experience with production pipelines, monitoring, and backtesting; familiarity with modern forecasting stacks or solvers (Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools).

- Operational fluency: Experience working directly alongside supply chain, warehouse, or logistics operations, including spending time on the floor to understand problems before framing models.

- Leadership & communication: Proven experience leading technical teams, hiring top talent

title: Prakitkant M&A Due Diligence (m/f/d)
description:
ÜBER BUENA

Buena wird von GV unterstützt und macht Immobilien einfacher: von der Wohnungssuche über den Kauf und die Finanzierung bis zur Verwaltung. Dafür kaufen wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland und entwickeln sie mit eigener Technologie und besseren Prozessen weiter. Unser Ziel: Immobilieneigentum und Vermögensaufbau für mehr Menschen zugänglich machen.

ÜBER DIE ROLLE

Bevor wir eine Hausverwaltung übernehmen, müssen wir ihr Geschäft verstehen. Wie belastbar sind die Zahlen? Welche Risiken stecken in den Verträgen? Was braucht das Unternehmen, um nach der Übernahme erfolgreich weiterzulaufen?

Als Praktikant:in M&A Due Diligence gehst du diesen Fragen nach. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Deal Lead und unserem Operations- und Deal-Team an laufenden Übernahmen. Dabei begleitest du Transaktionen vom ersten Datenraum über die Bewertung bis zur Entscheidung des Managements und zum Closing.

In unserem dreiköpfigen Team übernimmst du ab Tag eins eigene Workstreams und nimmst an Gesprächen mit den Geschäftsführern der Zielunternehmen teil. Deine Analysen fließen direkt in unsere Kaufentscheidung ein.

DEINE AUFGABEN

- Financial DD. Du analysierst BWAs, Jahresabschlüsse und Cashflows, prüfst Umsatz und verwaltete Einheiten und dokumentierst Red Flags. Du arbeitest an Kaufpreismodellen und rechnest Szenarien und Earn-out-Strukturen durch.

- Commercial & Operations DD. Du prüfst Objektlisten, Verwaltungsverträge und ERP-/Prozessdaten. Du bewertest Personal- und Kapazitätsbedarf und bereitest Fragen für die Gespräche mit der Geschäftsleitung vor.

- Entscheidungen vorbereiten. Du verdichtest deine Ergebnisse zu klaren Findings und Executive Summaries. Du bereitest Liegenschaftscontrolling und Liquiditätsplanung auf und lieferst Input für die Entscheidungsvorlage und die Anlagen zum Unternehmenskaufvertrag (SPA).

- Den DD-Prozess steuern. Du erstellst und pflegst Information Request Lists, organisierst den Datenraum in DataSite oder Google Drive und hältst fehlende Unterlagen nach. Du dokumentierst offene Fragen, Fortschritt und Ergebnisse in Linear.

- Eigene Workstreams verantworten. Je nach Erfahrung und Transaktion führst du einzelne DD-Workstreams von der ersten Datenanforderung bis zum Findings-Report.

DU PASST, WENN DU

- Bereits ein Praktikum oder eine Werkstudententätigkeit in M&A, Transaction Services, Corporate Finance, Investment Banking, Private Equity, Wirtschaftsprüfung oder transaktionsnaher Beratung absolviert hast.

- BWL, VWL, Finance, Accounting, (Wirtschafts-)Recht, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder etwas Vergleichbares studierst - ab dem fünften Semester oder im Master.

- GuV, BWA und Bilanz sicher lesen kannst und verstehst, was Umsatz, EBITDA, Working Capital und Verbindlichkeiten über ein Unternehmen aussagen.

- Bewertungsmethoden wie Multiples und DCF kennst und bereits angewendet hast.

- Excel sicher beherrschst: Pivot-Tabellen, XVERWEIS/SVERWEIS und das Aufbereiten und Konsolidieren unstrukturierter Daten.

- Sorgfältig arbeitest, Unstimmigkeiten hinterfragst und offene Punkte eigenständig klärst.

- Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sprichst und schreibst. Gespräche mit Geschäftsführern, Verträge und Finanzunterlagen sind überwiegend deutsch.

- Für mindestens drei, idealerweise sechs Monate Vollzeit verfügbar bist und aus unserem Berliner Büro arbeiten möchtest.

WAS DU BEI UNS LERNST

- Wie wir als Käufer Unternehmen prüfen, bewerten und übernehmen - bei einer zweistelligen Anzahl an Transaktionen pro Jahr.

- Wie aus Finanzdaten, Verträgen und Management-Gesprächen eine belastbare Kaufentscheidung entsteht.

- Wie Bewertung, Kaufvertrag und spätere Integration zusammenhängen.

Bei guter Zusammenarbeit gibt es eine Perspektive für den Einstieg nach dem Praktikum.

DEINE BENEFITS

- Bis zu 500 € Close-to-Office-Bonus, wenn du innerhalb von 10-20 Gehminuten zum Büro wohnst oder dorthin ziehst.

- 110 € Lunch-Budget pro Monat und 50 € Fitness-Zuschuss.

- 1.200 € jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget

description:
What you will do:
As an independent contractor, you will be working from home as a freelance transcriptionist and translator, making an accurate text document of the contents of audio, video, typed or handwritten material.
We transcribe oral history interviews (with WWII veterans, women in academia, farmers, midwives…), focus groups, financial forecasts or quarterly reports, tech webinars, commencement addresses, interviews about NGO work, educational reform or health care access, or anything else you could think of, and even occasionally TV shows. We don't do medical transcription.
Who we’re looking for:

• U.S. Citizens or U.S. Resident Alien as described on IRS form W-9.

• Bilingual transcriptionists/translators of Spanish and English.

• Fast and accurate typists (minimum of 80 wpm), who can deliver files on deadline without question.

• People with a wide range of interests or educational experiences. As the subject matter varies broadly, it’s easier to understand the flow of conversation when you have some context for what is being discussed.

Requirements

• Strong language, style, and punctuation skills, and the capability and willingness to follow our transcription style manual as well as project-specific instructions.

• Ability to verify names and terms via brief internet research. Much of the work we do is for archives, so these transcripts will become part of a historical record and need to be of high quality to reflect that permanence.

What you will need

• A reliable internet connection is a must. ATC sends project files via Dropbox links, so no special FTP setup is necessary.

• For confidentiality reasons, we require that you use an email address that no one else has access to.

• Transcripts should be returned to ATC as .doc files. You are not strictly required to use Microsoft Word; you can also use Open Office or some other program that has the capability to save as a .doc file as long as the formatting requirements are met and the functionality of the end product is indistinguishable from a document completed in Word.

• ATC highly recommends the use of transcription software (such as ExpressScribe) controlled via hotkeys or a foot pedal, and the use of good-quality headphones to cut down on ambient noise while you are transcribing.

How do I get hired as a freelance transcriptionist?
No calls, please. File your online application here and include:

• Current resume (PDF)

• Cover letter (PDF)

• A screenshot of the results from a three-minute typing test on www.typingtest.com (our minimum requirement is 80 wpm with 98% accuracy)

Forbes Advisor is scaling its Comparison business, and we’re looking for a Digital Experience Lead to help drive its next stage of growth. This is a hands-on role focused on improving conversion across our landing pages and customer journeys.

Our Comparison business connects customers with the right products across a panel of partners, earning revenue by sending high-intent, well-matched customers their way. With significant investment across paid acquisition, getting the experience right from the moment a customer lands with us is critical.

You’ll work closely with SEM, Product, Engineering, Design and Data to understand customer behaviour, identify the biggest opportunities and turn them into experiments and improvements that drive measurable commercial impact.

• Partner with Product, Engineering and Design to identify opportunities and take experiments and experience improvements from idea through to launch.

• Work with Data to ensure the right tracking and measurement are in place to make confident decisions.

• Commercially sharp and able to connect customer behaviour and conversion to revenue and wider business performance.

• Data-driven and curious, with the ability to spot opportunities and turn insight into action.

title: Security Operations Engineer
description:
Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team.

Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder.

Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France.

As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on-site interview as part of the final stages of the process.

We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have.

We’re transforming the collecting experience with technology that brings authentication, grading, and trading into the modern era. Our products are equalizing the playing field by providing tools that make complex research analytics - including pricing, scarcity reports, and historic sales data - accessible to every collector, old or new. Our engineering mission is to democratize technology while promoting innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning throughout the organization. We're seeking engineers to utilize advanced technology in agile settings, with a focus on improving the customer experience for every collector.

Collectors Cybersecurity team is committed to utilize cybersecurity, risk and privacy best practices on our platforms, leveraging signal intelligence and observability at scale to protect our customers, employees and our brand.

We’re looking for a Security Operations Engineer to join our Cybersecurity team to partner with the broader Product and Tech org and drive secure by default architectures and ensure the security and integrity of our infrastructure.
You’ll join our Cybersecurity Team and work from our Santa Ana, CA office. Remote or hybrid candidates will also be considered. We believe that there is significant value in in-person collaboration. If you live within a 1 hour commuting distance to one of our offices, you will be required to be onsite most of the time. This will be discussed further as part of the recruiting process.

What You’ll Do:

•
Drive Detection Engineering: Build, tune and manage high-confidence detections across cloud platforms (AWS/GCP), enterprise tooling (Okta, GWS, M365) and vendor products. Treat detections as code: version controlled, peer reviewed, tested in CI, and measured for precision and coverage against MITRE ATT&CK.

•
Incident Command and Containment: Serve as a senior responder for security incidents, driving triage, containment, forensics, and remediation, and authoring post-incident reviews that turn lessons into durable improvements.

•
Threat Hunting: Conduct proactive threat hunts across cloud, SaaS, identity and on-prem infrastructure, converting hypotheses and findings into new detections and hardened controls.

•
Tooling and Response Automation: Design and build automation and SOAR playbooks that reduce manual toil, accelerate response times, and improve alert enrichment and case management.

•
Security Telemetry : Own and improve the health of the security data pipeline

Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

THE ROLE

As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you’ll own a book of enterprise accounts across the UK and Europe, acting as a trusted advisor who drives adoption, retention and growth. You’ll partner closely with Sales to deliver a seamless onboarding experience and educate clients on a completely new way to create video content. Engaging stakeholders from day-to-day users through to the C-suite, you’ll make sure customers see clear ROI and become true champions of Synthesia.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Reporting to the Director of Customer Success of the UK, you are energetic, driven, and care deeply about the success of our customers

- As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will drive Synthesia’s future growth by building relationships with clients and turning them into happy users

- You will be helping educate clients on a totally new way to create video content, and work very closely with sales to create a cohesive onboarding experience for new users

- You are capable of engaging in business-level and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organisation, including the C-suite

- Ideal for an individual who wants to expand their career with a fast-growing software company

WE’D LOVE TO HEAR FROM YOU IF YOU HAVE

- Customer-facing experience in Customer Success Management / Client Service / Account Management / Technical Account Management / Implementation or similar ideally in B2B SaaS

- Experience in managing a Book of Business along with KPIs

- A track record in managing risk, forecasting, and identifying growth opportunities

- Establishing a trusted advisor relationship with our clients, driving value from Synthesia products and services

- Successfully onboarding new clients and building key relationships in the first critical months and beyond

- Coordinating and leading regular client check-ins with clear outcomes on client health and opportunities with senior stakeholder attendance

- Light video editing using the Synthesia platform

- Retention and growth of our enterprise clients

- Ensuring ROI and value is understood by clients, proactively looking for risks and opportunities

- You need to be fluent in English

- Based in London. This is a hybrid role where you need to be in the office 3 days a week.

 

WE’D BE PARTICULARLY EXCITED IF

- Experience at a fast-growing technology company

- Familiarity with AI or video tools

 

COMPENSATION

We offer a competitive salary, equity and benefits. Your offer will reflect your experience, skills and the scope of the role.

title: Regional Sales Director - Nashville
description:
“Mineralys Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing medicines to target hypertension and related comorbidities such as chronic kidney disease (CKD), obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) and other diseases driven by dysregulated aldosterone.  Its initial product candidate, lorundrostat, is a proprietary, orally administered, highly selective aldosterone synthase inhibitor.  Mineralys is headquartered in Radnor, Pennsylvania. For more information, please visit  https://mineralystx.com . Follow Mineralys on  LinkedIn ,  Twitter  and  Bluesky ”

Mineralys is a fully remote company.

Regional Sales Director

The Regional Sales Director (RSD) will play a critical role in the successful launch and growth of Mineralys’ first commercial product within an assigned region. This leader will be accountable for translating national strategy into regional execution, driving business performance through strong field leadership, cross-functional partnership, and disciplined execution against launch objectives.

The RSD will build and lead a high-performing team of territory managers, foster deep customer relationships, and ensure alignment with corporate priorities, compliance standards, and Mineralys’ values. This is a highly visible field leadership role requiring strong business acumen, launch experience, and the ability to lead with urgency in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Leadership / Launch Execution

• Lead all regional launch planning and execution activities to ensure successful market entry and sustained product uptake

• Translate national brand strategy into actionable regional business plans and field execution priorities

• Lead team to achieve or exceed sales goals, market share targets, and key performance metrics at launch and beyond

• Monitor market dynamics, customer feedback, and competitive intelligence to adjust strategy in real time

• Drive accountability for performance through data-driven decision making and disciplined execution

Team Leadership / Coaching

• Recruit, onboard, develop, and retain top-performing territory managers across the region

• Lead, coach, and motivate a team of approximately 8-12 territory managers

• Establish and maintain high level of disease state, clinical and product knowledge

• Evaluate performance of territory managers and coach to skill and career development through regular field contact

• Foster a high-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement

• Build strong succession plans and talent pipelines

Customer / Market Engagement

• Develop and maintain relationships with key healthcare providers, health systems, integrated delivery networks (IDNs) and strategic accounts

• Partner with territory managers on key customer interactions, access challenges, and develop account strategies

• Support pull-through with IDNs, organized customers, and priority accounts

• timely and effectively sharing of customer insights with internal stakeholders

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner closely with Market Access, Marketing, Medical Affairs, Training, Operations, and HR to support launch readiness and execution

• Provide field-driven input into brand planning, messaging, and tactical adjustments

• Collaborate with Area Sales Directors and peers to share best practices and drive consistency across regions

• Support national meetings, launch planning sessions, and field communications

Compliance / Operational Excellence

• Ensure all regional activities are conducted in full compliance with company policies, industry regulations, and legal standards

• Manage regional budgets and resources effectively

• Maintain accurate forecasting, CRM utilization, and reporting discipline

• Uphold Mineralys’ values of collaboration, integrity, quality, trust, and urgency

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree pref

title: Data Architect (Microsoft Fabric)

Built primarily on Microsoft Fabric, Unified Data will establish a centralized, governed data foundation that brings together real-time operational events and historical data across enterprise technology domains to support reporting, analytics, automation, AI, and reusable data products.
You will define the target-state architecture, data organization and modeling standards, integration patterns, security and governance framework, and engineering practices for the platform. Operating within a complex and evolving technical environment, you will exercise independent judgment to evaluate multiple architectural approaches, assess interdependencies and technical tradeoffs, and determine solutions where established patterns or precedent may be limited. The data landscape spans areas including IT service management, employee and workplace technology, endpoints and assets, identity and access, infrastructure and network services, collaboration platforms, operational telemetry, and enterprise master and reference data.
In addition to serving as the lead architect, you will act as a technical leader for the delivery team, providing guidance and translating architecture and business requirements into actionable engineering work, helping create and refine epics, stories, and tasks, identifying dependencies and sequencing, and ensuring work is aligned to the appropriate resources and teams while providing technical guidance throughout implementation.

title: Credit Risk Analyst Commercial Underwriter
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies-from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups-use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Credit Risk team is responsible for managing the credit risk generated by businesses processing payments on Stripe. The team combines commercial underwriting, portfolio management, analytics, and cross-functional partnership to protect Stripe from financial loss while enabling strong businesses to grow. The APAC Credit Risk team supports a diverse portfolio of businesses across the region. We partner closely with Sales, Legal, Treasury, Finance, Product, Operations, and other Risk teams to make sound, timely credit decisions and develop scalable approaches to managing risk.

What you’ll do

You will underwrite and manage a portfolio of Stripe’s largest and fastest-growing businesses across APAC. You will evaluate complex business models and financial information, develop clear credit recommendations, and identify mitigations that protect Stripe while supporting sustainable user growth.

Responsibilities

• Underwrite and manage a portfolio of Stripe’s largest and fastest-growing businesses across APAC.

• Evaluate business models, financial statements, cash-flow forecasts, transaction patterns, and other relevant information to assess credit risk.

• Develop clear, data-driven credit recommendations and tailored risk mitigations that balance Stripe’s exposure with users’ ability to grow.

• Build expertise across APAC industries, geographies, payment flows, and operating models, and apply this context to underwriting and portfolio decisions.

• Provide credit insights that support onboarding, ongoing portfolio management, commercial decisions, and merchant-pricing analysis.

• Conduct periodic and trigger-based reviews, identify changes in risk, and recommend timely actions to manage Stripe’s exposure.

• Support the refinement of systems, tools, and processes to help the team deliver on key performance indicators, such as credit loss targets or portfolio coverage metrics.

• Communicate credit decisions, risk considerations, and mitigation requirements clearly to internal stakeholders and to users, including CFOs and CEOs.

• Partner with Sales, Legal, Treasury, Finance, Product, Engineering, Operations, and other Risk teams to resolve complex cases and improve Stripe’s credit-risk capabilities.

• Identify recurring portfolio trends and underwriting gaps, and translate these insights into improvements to policies, controls, and decision frameworks.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 5+ years of relevant experience in commercial credit underwriting, financial-risk modeling, cash-flow forecasting, or portfolio credit risk.

• A bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Strong accounting knowledge and demonstrated ability to evaluate financial statements, cash flows, business models, and sources of repayment.

• Ability to synthesize quantitative and qualitative information into a clear credit-risk narrative, approval rationale, and mitigation strategy.

• Sound commercial judgment and the ability to balance financial-risk considerations with user growth and business objectives.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex credit decisions to senior inter

title: Senior Employment Solicitor (Consultant)
description:
Senior Employment Solicitor (Consultant)

We are looking for an experienced Employment Solicitor with a minimum of 10 years’ PQE and strong contentious and non-contentious experience to join Harper James on a consultancy basis.

This is an exciting opportunity to work with a growing and diverse client base ranging from innovative start-ups to established national and international businesses.

You will advise on a wide range of employment law matters within a modern, tech-enabled law firm. As a consultant within our flexible model, you will manage your own caseload while benefiting from the support, infrastructure and collaborative culture of a forward-thinking national firm.

What you’ll be doing

You will take the lead on a broad range of contentious and non-contentious employment matters, supporting businesses with day-to-day workforce issues, strategic projects and employment disputes.

You will work closely with founders, senior leadership teams, HR teams and in-house counsel, providing clear, pragmatic advice that helps clients manage risk and achieve their commercial objectives.

Your work is likely to include advising on matters such as general day-to-day employment law support to SMEs and larger companies;

• business restructures & redundancies (including collective);

• overseeing discrimination and whistle-blowing cases;

• advising on TUPE transfers, including corporate support;

• drafting consultancy agreements and advising on status (with a good knowledge of IR35);

• drafting and advising on director service agreements and contracts of employment;

• managing disciplinary and grievance processes; and

• handling senior exec severances.

As part of the wider Harper James legal team, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with colleagues across Corporate, Commercial and other practice areas, particularly where employment issues intersect with transactions, business growth and organisational change.

What we’re looking for

• A minimum of 10 years’ PQE with strong experience across both contentious and non-contentious employment law

• Demonstrable experience advising employers on complex workforce issues and managing Employment Tribunal litigation

• Experience advising founder-led businesses, start-ups and scale-ups would be advantageous

• Ability to manage matters independently and deliver pragmatic, commercially focused advicel

• Excellent client relationship and stakeholder management skills

The Harper James difference

We are a tech-driven, agile law firm where lawyers are empowered with modern legal technology to maximise efficiency, productivity and work-life balance.

Our consultant model offers experienced solicitors flexibility, autonomy and the ability to work remotely, while remaining part of a supportive national team.

At Harper James , we keep things straightforward. We are relaxed and informal but well organised. There is no politics and no big egos - if people around us succeed, so do we. We welcome proactive, self-motivated solicitors who thrive in a modern legal environment and are passionate about delivering exceptional client service.

You’ll excel as part of the HJ team if you

• Are a quick learner, ready to adapt to new systems and technologies

• Are interested in using AI tools to improve efficiency and productivity

• Have a solid working knowledge of Microsoft 365 products (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)

• Can confidently navigate SharePoint to manage and collaborate on work

• Have a keen eye for detail when drafting documents, ensuring consistency and professionalism

The bottom line

This is an opportunity to play an important part in the continued growth of the business, working alongside a great team of people who all contribute to our shared success.

We are offering a competitive consultancy rate with flexibility and autonomy as part of the Harper James consultant model.

NO AGENCIES PLEASE

description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

Applied Intuition entered the Japan market in 2019. The company has rapidly grown and established strategic relationships with major Japanese automotive OEM customers. Based in Otemachi area, the Tokyo site consists of more than 60 employees who previously come from Google, Mobileye, TIER IV, Woven by Toyota, Tesla and other renowned companies.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Your role will focus on ensuring execution and managing the test campaigns that ensure systems and components meet all required specifications, standards, and customer expectations. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to define testing criteria, develop test plans, and oversee the execution of both verification and validation processes. Your work will be critical to enable our development of a production-ready software for on-road vehicles.

In addition to your testing contributions, by working in our dynamic and customer-focused team culture, you will contribute to and learn from best practices in the automotive industry. We move fast and we focus on excellence, for our products and for our business. If you are hands-on and looking for a place to have a multiplying effect on making automotive systems a reality, Applied Intuition is the place for you!

AT APPLIED INTUITION, YOU WILL:

- Set up Test Management for Autonomous Driving and lead efforts for test execution

- Collaborate with system development teams to understand system requirements and define appropriate verification and validation plans

- Utilize various testing methodologies and Applied’s tools to conduct functional, non-functional, regression, and performance testing in simulation and on-road

- Analyze test results, identify issues and trends, and work with engineering teams to troubleshoot and resolve problems

- Ensure compliance with industry standards, regulatory requirements, and quality management systems.

- Document all V&V activities and provide comprehensive reports to stakeholders

- Provide release recommendation based on test results
